parameters.query: SELECT message FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id = $1 AND $1 <> '' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.notes: No retry here on purpose: notify_owner retries its own Airtable and Telegram nodes (2 tries, 5 s). No onError either: if the owner was not told, the run must fail BEFORE Flag Escalated.

nodes.name: Already Escalated?
nodes.notes: Task 20 (dialog 09): two agent runs of one client that overlap (a client sending messages a few seconds apart) can both call escalate; the second found the row already escalated by the first and still sent the owner a second 🚨 Escalation. A client whose row is already escalated is not reported again: true -> Result (ESCALATED), no owner message, nothing written. WF-1 stops escalated clients before the agent, so only such overlapping runs get here. A failed Client lookup has no fields and takes the normal path.

nodes.name: Flag Escalated
nodes.notes: escalated_at is written in the same update as the status: it is the marker WF-1 reads to notice that the owner resolved this escalation (status no longer escalated) and to reset the agent's chat memory of the conversation once. Already Escalated? keeps an overlapping second run from moving it.
